meta.title: Triumphant Return
meta.description: The story has come to an end, but our adventure has only begun.

units.rawText: And so, the game in the break room comes to an end.
units.displayText: And so, the game in the break room comes to an end.

spans.text: And so, the game in the break room comes to an end.

units.rawText: Through the valiant efforts of the explorers, the Witch's form finally vanishes.
units.displayText: Through the valiant efforts of the explorers, the Witch's form finally vanishes.

spans.text: Through the valiant efforts of the explorers, the Witch's form finally vanishes.

units.rawText: You have escaped the clutches of the Wicked Witch, and the story is at an end.
units.displayText: You have escaped the clutches of the Wicked Witch, and the story is at an end.

spans.text: You have escaped the clutches of the Wicked Witch, and the story is at an end.

units.rawText: Still, there are many more mysteries to be solved. The matter of the princess' curse, the mysterious Pumpkin Jack, and Antonina the Witch, who could come back at any time... Your adventure is far from over.
units.displayText: Still, there are many more mysteries to be solved. The matter of the princess' curse, the mysterious Pumpkin Jack, and Antonina the Witch, who could come back at any time... Your adventure is far from over.

spans.text: Still, there are many more mysteries to be solved. The matter of the princess' curse, the mysterious Pumpkin Jack, and Antonina the Witch, who could come back at any time... Your adventure is far from over.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Strange Blue—To Be Continued.</color>
units.displayText: Strange Blue—To Be Continued.

spans.text: Strange Blue—To Be Continued.

units.rawText: Whew... It's over...
units.displayText: Whew... It's over...

spans.text: Whew... It's over...

units.rawText: The moment Antonina finishes the last line of her narration, Helix immediately gets up and runs over to the corner of the break room, where she gulps down a cold drink.
units.displayText: The moment Antonina finishes the last line of her narration, Helix immediately gets up and runs over to the corner of the break room, where she gulps down a cold drink.

spans.text: The moment Antonina finishes the last line of her narration, Helix immediately gets up and runs over to the corner of the break room, where she gulps down a cold drink.

units.rawText: You know, is there a need to have to go so far away for a drink? Also, good on her for being able to go so long without water.
units.displayText: You know, is there a need to have to go so far away for a drink? Also, good on her for being able to go so long without water.

spans.text: You know, is there a need to have to go so far away for a drink? Also, good on her for being able to go so long without water.

units.rawText: Congratulations, everyone. You've reached a happy ending. Thank you for your hard work.
units.displayText: Congratulations, everyone. You've reached a happy ending. Thank you for your hard work.

spans.text: Congratulations, everyone. You've reached a happy ending. Thank you for your hard work.

units.rawText: Hm? A happy ending, you say? I seem to recall my character becoming a ghost.
units.displayText: Hm? A happy ending, you say? I seem to recall my character becoming a ghost.

spans.text: Hm? A happy ending, you say? I seem to recall my character becoming a ghost.

units.rawText: That's why it's a happy ending.
units.displayText: That's why it's a happy ending.

spans.text: That's why it's a happy ending.

units.rawText: So you WERE taking out your personal grudges on me.
units.displayText: So you WERE taking out your personal grudges on me.

spans.text: So you WERE taking out your personal grudges on me.

units.rawText: It ended too soon! Is that really all!?
units.displayText: It ended too soon! Is that really all!?

spans.text: It ended too soon! Is that really all!?

units.rawText: Will our next summit be in the hands of the weaver of fates?
units.displayText: Will our next summit be in the hands of the weaver of fates?

spans.text: Will our next summit be in the hands of the weaver of fates?

units.rawText: Go with a midnight casket theme for next time! How about that? Is that okay, oh great and mighty Miss Anna?
units.displayText: Go with a midnight casket theme for next time! How about that? Is that okay, oh great and mighty Miss Anna?

spans.text: Go with a midnight casket theme for next time! How about that? Is that okay, oh great and mighty Miss Anna?

units.rawText: Understood. I'll arrange for Nora to write in a chatterbox coffin next time.
units.displayText: Understood. I'll arrange for Nora to write in a chatterbox coffin next time.

spans.text: Understood. I'll arrange for Nora to write in a chatterbox coffin next time.

units.rawText: A chatterbox? Am I really that much of a chatterbox? (Sob) I'm starting to feel depressed...
units.displayText: A chatterbox? Am I really that much of a chatterbox? (Sob) I'm starting to feel depressed...

spans.text: A chatterbox? Am I really that much of a chatterbox? (Sob) I'm starting to feel depressed...

units.rawText: While the rest of the group is abuzz with activity, one corner of the room is strangely quiet.
units.displayText: While the rest of the group is abuzz with activity, one corner of the room is strangely quiet.

spans.text: While the rest of the group is abuzz with activity, one corner of the room is strangely quiet.

units.displayText: Yanny sits quietly on his chair, staring intently at the miniature of the sailing ship.

spans.text: Yanny sits quietly on his chair, staring intently at the miniature of the sailing ship.

units.rawText: Yanny, how do you feel? Are there any abnormalities in your neural cloud?
units.displayText: Yanny, how do you feel? Are there any abnormalities in your neural cloud?

spans.text: Yanny, how do you feel? Are there any abnormalities in your neural cloud?

units.rawText: Ah! I'm fine, Professor! Thanks for your concern!
units.displayText: Ah! I'm fine, Professor! Thanks for your concern!

spans.text: Ah! I'm fine, Professor! Thanks for your concern!

units.rawText: Do you remember anything?
units.displayText: Do you remember anything?

spans.text: Do you remember anything?

units.rawText: Not yet, but... when I was battling with the waves, I felt both afraid and excited.
units.displayText: Not yet, but... when I was battling with the waves, I felt both afraid and excited.

spans.text: Not yet, but... when I was battling with the waves, I felt both afraid and excited.

units.rawText: I'm sure that my love for the sea isn't just a line of code written into my neural cloud!
units.displayText: I'm sure that my love for the sea isn't just a line of code written into my neural cloud!

spans.text: I'm sure that my love for the sea isn't just a line of code written into my neural cloud!

units.rawText: If it helps you unravel that mystery, then this game was worth it.
units.displayText: If it helps you unravel that mystery, then this game was worth it.

spans.text: If it helps you unravel that mystery, then this game was worth it.

units.rawText: Thank you, Professor.
units.displayText: Thank you, Professor.

spans.text: Thank you, Professor.

units.rawText: Professor? Do you have any suggestions for this game?
units.displayText: Professor? Do you have any suggestions for this game?

spans.text: Professor? Do you have any suggestions for this game?

units.rawText: Seriously? I'm a ghost; what could I have experienced?
units.displayText: Seriously? I'm a ghost; what could I have experienced?

spans.text: Seriously? I'm a ghost; what could I have experienced?

units.rawText: Well, you did it to yourself.
units.displayText: Well, you did it to yourself.

spans.text: Well, you did it to yourself.

units.rawText: (Sob) I'm a chatterbox coffin...
units.displayText: (Sob) I'm a chatterbox coffin...

spans.text: (Sob) I'm a chatterbox coffin...

units.rawText: It was really fun... but could I be a good girl next time? It really bothered me to cause problems for everyone...
units.displayText: It was really fun... but could I be a good girl next time? It really bothered me to cause problems for everyone...

spans.text: It was really fun... but could I be a good girl next time? It really bothered me to cause problems for everyone...

units.rawText: It was a rare experience.
units.displayText: It was a rare experience.

spans.text: It was a rare experience.

units.rawText: Eh. Come on, Professor.
units.displayText: Eh. Come on, Professor.

spans.text: Eh. Come on, Professor.

units.rawText: Well, even if you ask me... My character just came on screen to die.
units.displayText: Well, even if you ask me... My character just came on screen to die.

spans.text: Well, even if you ask me... My character just came on screen to die.

units.rawText: All I can say is that the game itself was fun. But the script was a mashup of a ghost story, gags, and horror elements at times... Let me guess, did Nora write it?
units.displayText: All I can say is that the game itself was fun. But the script was a mashup of a ghost story, gags, and horror elements at times... Let me guess, did Nora write it?

units.displayText: Hm? Did you spill your water again, Helix?

spans.text: Hm? Did you spill your water again, Helix?

units.rawText: I look toward the source of the noise and see Helix staring outside the window with a terrified expression on her face. She doesn't seem to have noticed that her cup has slipped from her fingers.
units.displayText: I look toward the source of the noise and see Helix staring outside the window with a terrified expression on her face. She doesn't seem to have noticed that her cup has slipped from her fingers.

units.displayText: Hm? Outside the window?

spans.text: Hm? Outside the window?

units.displayText: I reflexively look outside, and a savage silhouette flits past.

units.displayText: What was that? Did you see it?

units.displayText: I look back to confirm what I saw with everyone, but just then, the lights go out.

units.displayText: Uwah!

units.rawText: This... this is...
units.displayText: This... this is...

units.displayText: Muahahahaha...

spans.text: Muahahahaha...

units.rawText: Who's that?!
units.displayText: Who's that?!

spans.text: Who's that?!

units.displayText: I look around, searching for the source of the voice.

units.displayText: Hand over your parts!

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.displayText: I reflexively take a step back and prepare to meet the threat.

units.displayText: Don't, don't, don't hurt the Professor!

units.displayText: Yanny stands up and gets between me and the pumpkin.

units.rawText: Puzzle... So it was you.
units.displayText: Puzzle... So it was you.

spans.text: Puzzle... So it was you.

units.displayText: Hehehe, don't blame me for being ruthless, Professor.

units.displayText: Helix puts a hand on her chest and puts down the analyzer that she's holding.

spans.text: Helix puts a hand on her chest and puts down the analyzer that she's holding.

units.rawText: Um... the last time I went to Miss Puzzle's room, I saw her statue and passed out... (whimper)
units.displayText: Um... the last time I went to Miss Puzzle's room, I saw her statue and passed out... (whimper)

spans.text: Um... the last time I went to Miss Puzzle's room, I saw her statue and passed out... (whimper)

units.rawText: Aw, that was just an accident. No, wait, this was just an accident too... Or should I say it's collateral damage?

units.displayText: Th-thank goodness...

units.displayText: Yanny slumps to the ground and exhales heavily. Looks like he was pretty frightened too.

spans.text: Yanny slumps to the ground and exhales heavily. Looks like he was pretty frightened too.

units.rawText: Ah... Sorry, I was trying to mess with the Professor without alerting the two of you.
units.displayText: Ah... Sorry, I was trying to mess with the Professor without alerting the two of you.

spans.text: Ah... Sorry, I was trying to mess with the Professor without alerting the two of you.

units.rawText: So you rushed off to get this pumpkin head for the prank?
units.displayText: So you rushed off to get this pumpkin head for the prank?

spans.text: So you rushed off to get this pumpkin head for the prank?

units.rawText: When did you and Antonina plan this?

spans.text: When did you and Antonina plan this?

units.rawText: Hehehe, how was it? Pretty good, no? I prepared that pumpkin head just for this story's climax.

spans.text: Hehehe, how was it? Pretty good, no? I prepared that pumpkin head just for this story's climax.

units.rawText: But you guys changed the script too much, Professor! I didn't even have a chance to show up!
units.displayText: But you guys changed the script too much, Professor! I didn't even have a chance to show up!

spans.text: But you guys changed the script too much, Professor! I didn't even have a chance to show up!

units.rawText: After all, it was supposed to be the released Pumpkin Jack chasing you, not the Witch. Although, judging by the picture I just took, perhaps it was better this way.

Aieee! Guh...

units.rawText: <size=28>...Ah... Great Author Nora, would you like to rest for a bit...</size>
units.displayText: ...Ah... Great Author Nora, would you like to rest for a bit...

spans.text: ...Ah... Great Author Nora, would you like to rest for a bit...

units.rawText: Puzzle's weak voice is overcome by Nora's excited exclamation.
units.displayText: Puzzle's weak voice is overcome by Nora's excited exclamation.

spans.text: Puzzle's weak voice is overcome by Nora's excited exclamation.

units.rawText: How could I rest? The Professor approved all the writing I produced while slacking off! AND they agreed to use the tabletop simulator to turn all these scripts into movies!
units.displayText: How could I rest? The Professor approved all the writing I produced while slacking off! AND they agreed to use the tabletop simulator to turn all these scripts into movies!

spans.text: How could I rest? The Professor approved all the writing I produced while slacking off! AND they agreed to use the tabletop simulator to turn all these scripts into movies!

units.rawText: Don't worry. The Nora who used to delay her scripts is a thing of the past. I'm firing on all cylinders now! I can submit a new script by this afternoon!
units.displayText: Don't worry. The Nora who used to delay her scripts is a thing of the past. I'm firing on all cylinders now! I can submit a new script by this afternoon!

spans.text: Don't worry. The Nora who used to delay her scripts is a thing of the past. I'm firing on all cylinders now! I can submit a new script by this afternoon!

units.rawText: Save... Save me... Someone save me!
units.displayText: Save... Save me... Someone save me!

spans.text: Save... Save me... Someone save me!

units.rawText: In the Ops Room of the Oasis.
units.displayText: In the Ops Room of the Oasis.

spans.text: In the Ops Room of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Finally, I've finished all the work that had accumulated yesterday.
units.displayText: Finally, I've finished all the work that had accumulated yesterday.

spans.text: Finally, I've finished all the work that had accumulated yesterday.

units.rawText: Those two pranksters ought to be pretty busy now.
units.displayText: Those two pranksters ought to be pretty busy now.

spans.text: Those two pranksters ought to be pretty busy now.

units.rawText: I guess I can take a break now... Hm?
units.displayText: I guess I can take a break now... Hm?

spans.text: I guess I can take a break now... Hm?

units.rawText: The door to the Ops Room opens. Clotho, Helix, and Yanny each enter, holding a little box.
units.displayText: The door to the Ops Room opens. Clotho, Helix, and Yanny each enter, holding a little box.

spans.text: The door to the Ops Room opens. Clotho, Helix, and Yanny each enter, holding a little box.

units.rawText: Ah, are you free today, Professor?
units.displayText: Ah, are you free today, Professor?

spans.text: Ah, are you free today, Professor?

units.rawText: Hm? What's up?
units.displayText: Hm? What's up?

spans.text: Hm? What's up?

units.rawText: Ah... We want to play a game with you, Professor!
units.displayText: Ah... We want to play a game with you, Professor!

spans.text: Ah... We want to play a game with you, Professor!

units.rawText: And I've got a part on it this time, too!
units.displayText: And I've got a part on it this time, too!

spans.text: And I've got a part on it this time, too!

units.rawText: It is an honor to be able to play another game with you.
units.displayText: It is an honor to be able to play another game with you.

spans.text: It is an honor to be able to play another game with you.

units.rawText: Oh? Looks like Antonina put in overtime and finished the portable version of the tabletop simulator.
units.displayText: Oh? Looks like Antonina put in overtime and finished the portable version of the tabletop simulator.

spans.text: Oh? Looks like Antonina put in overtime and finished the portable version of the tabletop simulator.

units.rawText: And it turns out I've just finished work... Although we're missing a gamemaster.
units.displayText: And it turns out I've just finished work... Although we're missing a gamemaster.

spans.text: And it turns out I've just finished work... Although we're missing a gamemaster.

units.rawText: (Pants) Surely nobody will catch me while I'm hiding here, right... And that damn Professor ought to have knocked off by now... Urk?
units.displayText: (Pants) Surely nobody will catch me while I'm hiding here, right... And that damn Professor ought to have knocked off by now... Urk?

spans.text: (Pants) Surely nobody will catch me while I'm hiding here, right... And that damn Professor ought to have knocked off by now... Urk?

units.rawText: Antonina enters the room, fatigue written all over the face, but the moment she sees us, she freezes up.
units.displayText: Antonina enters the room, fatigue written all over the face, but the moment she sees us, she freezes up.

spans.text: Antonina enters the room, fatigue written all over the face, but the moment she sees us, she freezes up.

units.rawText: ...Sorry, I must have gotten the wrong room.
units.displayText: ...Sorry, I must have gotten the wrong room.

spans.text: ...Sorry, I must have gotten the wrong room.

units.rawText: Oho, a gamemaster just delivered herself to us. Yanny, Helix, get her.
units.displayText: Oho, a gamemaster just delivered herself to us. Yanny, Helix, get her.

spans.text: Oho, a gamemaster just delivered herself to us. Yanny, Helix, get her.

units.rawText: W-Wait!?
units.displayText: W-Wait!?

spans.text: W-Wait!?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, the break room is full now, and everyone's enjoying these games.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, the break room is full now, and everyone's enjoying these games.

spans.text: Unfortunately, the break room is full now, and everyone's enjoying these games.

units.rawText: Would you like to play in the Ops Room?
units.displayText: Would you like to play in the Ops Room?

spans.text: Would you like to play in the Ops Room?

units.rawText: Ah... Professor, if it's okay...
units.displayText: Ah... Professor, if it's okay...

spans.text: Ah... Professor, if it's okay...

units.rawText: Could we play it at the "sea" near the Oasis?
units.displayText: Could we play it at the "sea" near the Oasis?

spans.text: Could we play it at the "sea" near the Oasis?

units.rawText: The sea? You mean the Oasis' simulated marine zone? Miss Chelsea mentioned it before, but I haven't had the chance to see it myself.
units.displayText: The sea? You mean the Oasis' simulated marine zone? Miss Chelsea mentioned it before, but I haven't had the chance to see it myself.

spans.text: The sea? You mean the Oasis' simulated marine zone? Miss Chelsea mentioned it before, but I haven't had the chance to see it myself.

units.rawText: That's a great idea. As it turns out, this game is called Strange Blue 2.
units.displayText: That's a great idea. As it turns out, this game is called Strange Blue 2.

spans.text: That's a great idea. As it turns out, this game is called Strange Blue 2.

units.rawText: Playing a sea-themed game by the sea has a special nuance to it too.
units.displayText: Playing a sea-themed game by the sea has a special nuance to it too.

spans.text: Playing a sea-themed game by the sea has a special nuance to it too.

units.rawText: Please let me rest for a bit... My slack time is...
units.displayText: Please let me rest for a bit... My slack time is...

spans.text: Please let me rest for a bit... My slack time is...

units.rawText: Just stuff the gamemaster inside me.
units.displayText: Just stuff the gamemaster inside me.

spans.text: Just stuff the gamemaster inside me.

units.rawText: Accompanied by laughter and wails, we leave the Ops Room together.
units.displayText: Accompanied by laughter and wails, we leave the Ops Room together.

spans.text: Accompanied by laughter and wails, we leave the Ops Room together.
